info.name: rust
info.typing: Statically typed with full inference; trait-based generics; ownership in the type system
info.gc: None — ownership + borrow checking enforced at compile time
info.runtime: No runtime — produces a standalone executable
info.design_notes: Rust matches C++ on speed without needing manual memory hygiene: the borrow checker proves at compile time that references don't outlive their owners and that aliasing rules are respected. Generics monomorphize, so abstractions compile down to the same machine code you'd write by hand.
key_traits: C/C++ class performance with memory + thread safety guarantees
No GC, no runtime — predictable latency
Iterator chains optimize to tight loops
Steeper learning curve than most languages on this list
info.peak_speed: Within ~1.0–1.1× of C++; sometimes faster on safe-by-default code
